special_events.name: DBCTNZ - Harela Celebration
special_events.tagline: Lets celebrate Harela, an folk festival from Uttarakhand, dedicated to mother nature. This is a Pot-luck event so come along with some delicious food from the state. for any questions please text/call : 022-172-7167 or 021-045-8783.
